[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Reformation advocated for a direct personal relationship between the individual and God, challenging reliance on church hierarchy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Believers could interpret the Bible for themselves rather than relying solely on priests and bishops.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Reformation introduced the principle of sola scriptura, asserting that the Bible alone is the ultimate source of religious authority.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Catholic Church experienced a decline in power and influence due to the Reformation, leading to the establishment of Protestant denominations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Reformation resulted in significant political and social changes in Europe, including wars and conflicts over religious differences.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Reformation sparked a renewed emphasis on education, leading to advances in literacy and the spread of education throughout Europe.
